blocks.text: Complete ten sparring rounds, win or lose.
Reward: Cosmetic only; no training XP, skill points, currency or combat bonus.
Completed computer sparring rounds with a connected pet. Practice, sample fighters and dummy tests do not count. Saved per pet in this browser; export preserves a copy.
